name: void-runner-3d-relay
description: Local relay for Void Runner 3D blockchain leaderboard

scripts.validate:release: npm run test:relay && npm run test:relay:http && npm run test:relay:admin && npm run test:game
scripts.coverage:relay: npx c8 --reporter=text --reporter=lcov --reporter=html --all --include=leaderboard-relay.js --exclude=*.test.js node relay.test.js && npx c8 --reporter=text --reporter=lcov --reporter=html --all --include=leaderboard-relay.js --exclude=*.test.js node relay-http.test.js
